subject: error: Failed to create the shared library on CRAN/Solaris

messages.author: f0085bf5ed318bc6
messages.subject: error: Failed to create the shared library on CRAN/Solaris
parts:
Hi,
I've recently developed an R package (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/nimbleCarbon/index.html) similar to nimbleEcology but focused on radiocarbon dating. The package is currently on CRAN and has passed all checks, but now it is getting an Error on r-patched-solaris-x86 (see here). I was unable to reproduce the error when checking via rhub (see here) so really have no clue - but was wondering if anyone has possible ideas on where I should start looking. All I got from CRAN check is:

** testing if installed package can be loaded from temporary location 
Registering the following user-provided distributions: dLogisticGrowth 
Registering the following user-provided distributions: dExponentialGrowth 
Registering the following user-provided distributions: dDoubleExponentialGrowth Registering the following user-provided distributions: dExponentialLogisticGrowth Registering the following user-provided distributions: dLogisticExponentialGrowth 
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘nimbleCarbon’: .onAttach failed in attachNamespace() for 'nimbleCarbon', details: 
 call: NULL 
 error: Failed to create the shared library. Run 'printErrors()' to see the compilation errors.

I suspect the error is related to either registerDistributions() or to compileNimble()  - (see here), but that is all I got for now...  Thanks in advance!

All Best,
Enrico
